target_customer: Active retail investors with brokerage, retirement and crypto accounts
problem: Retail investors cannot watch their holdings around the clock or cut through noise. Astor connects to accounts, monitors holdings and sends alerts, briefs and scenario analysis, with trades only after user approval.
business_model: Consumer subscription: Free, Pro 19 dollars per month, Max 29 dollars per month per the company site; SEC registered investment adviser

founders.name: Bruno Koba
founders.background_notes: YC page: built machine learning models at Nubank.

founders.name: Daniel Tulha Hochstetler
founders.background_notes: YC page: worked on production AI agents and large-scale systems.

competitors.name: Robinhood Cortex
competitors.what: Premium AI research assistant inside Robinhood Gold, analysis not trading
competitors.traction_then: Launched at the Gold event in March 2025; later reports of over one million users

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating brokerage data, filings and signals into reliable alerts and briefs with an LLM is standard engineering, with extra work for regulated adviser compliance and trade approval flows.

defensibility.rationale: SEC investment adviser registration is a modest barrier, but brokerages like Robinhood ship similar AI tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Robinhood shipped Cortex in March 2025 and agentic trading later, so brokerages absorbed parts of the wedge; no action against Astor found.

market_need_then: Retail investor participation was high and AI research tools were emerging, while personalised advice was costly and mostly reserved for larger accounts.

branding.domain_note: Uses astor.app. The YC contact address uses joingaus.com, consistent with the earlier Gaus name.

identity.visual_style: phone mockups, glowing accents, clean modern look
identity.voice_and_tone: plain language, confident, conversational like a text message

branding.brand_signature: Text and iMessage style alerts from a personal investing agent

rebrands.why: Not explained; one profile says the product moved to a mobile account connected adviser after YC and changed its name

brand_strength.rationale: Short, friendly name and clear tagline, but another Astor investing community was covered by TechCrunch in 2024 and no community or virality evidence found.

pivots.from: Gaus, a web product described as Cursor for retail investors
pivots.to: Astor, a mobile account connected investing agent
pivots.why: Single secondary profile; reason and date not stated

outcome_analysis: Astor is active and raised a 5M seed announced in April 2026 about eight months after its Summer 2025 batch, led by Monashees with several fintech funds. Founders with Nubank, Monashees, Stripe and Robinhood backgrounds fit the space, and it is an SEC registered adviser. Risk is that brokerages like Robinhood ship similar AI features.
notes: Seed amount and lead confirmed by several outlets; date is April 23 per the company blog headline and 24 or 26 April per others. Investor list is from the company site and one report. VCBacked lists 500K total, ignored as conflicting. Thousands of users and 200M connected accounts are unverified secondary claims. The Gaus rename rests on one profile.
